body: This has been fixed with composable index templates (they get no filter at all, rather than an invalid filter), however, I think the Alias validation should throw an error on the unknown field `bool` so that it's apparent to the user what's happening.

Relates to #61009.

The main changes are:
1. Throw an error if there are some unknown fields such as `bool` or some tokens such as `[]`  in the alias parameter when creating index template or creating index.
2. Add some tests for the change.

issue.body:
Relates to #61009， the origin PR #68807 has been reverted by #71739 because there are some failed tests such as `org.elasticsearch.client.indices.CreateIndexRequestTests.testFromXContent` and `org.elasticsearch.client.indices.PutIndexTemplateRequestTests.testFromXContent`.

This new PR resolves the test failures.

The test failures relate to the line: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/048ad991162316a9dba24f0e6a2145d858dd4b3d/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/action/admin/indices/alias/Alias.java#L279

because `is_write_index` can be null, when parsing the alias by the new added code it will throw an IllegalArgumentException with message `Unknown token [VALUE_NULL] in alias...`.
